## Record Payment

The single writer for payment state (spec addendum decision B): creates a **Payment** against an invoice and, in the same command, (1) appends it to `Invoice.payments` so the invoice's Paid/Balance-due rows stay truthful, (2) flips invoice status to `partial` or `paid` by comparing the running total to the line-item sum, and (3) writes `Account.firstPaidAt` once — the monotonic event fact behind `isCustomer`. Refuses void invoices and non-positive amounts.

Commands cannot hold `containedExamples` — the linked example is the natural target: an overdue unpaid invoice.

**Non-goals:** refunds/chargebacks, payment-gateway integration, currency conversion (payment currency defaults to the invoice's).

**Load-state lesson (stage 2, 2026-08-10):** the command re-fetches the invoice via GetCardCommand before reading payments/account — callers may pass cards with unloaded links; the first live run only worked because the app UI happened to have loaded them.
